_what: The make tiers of the ad-volume lane. A tier names a house clip route (components/generative-model-house) and the resolution it makes at. The test tier makes every concept; only a winner (by the numbers) is made again at the finish tier. Credits are read live from the Higgsfield cost command; the numbers here are only what was read on the date shown.

test.why: the house's Wan 3.0 route at 480p in reference mode: the kit's cast and product pictures go in as references, so no new start picture is drawn

test-seedance.why: the house default take model at 480p, made as a draft so a winner can be finished from it within seven days

finish.why: a winner, re-made (or its draft finished) at full size

_spend_floor: The make step never takes the account's balance below this line. The account refills itself with a paid top-up when it falls under 300 credits (read 15 Nov 2026), so spending past the line is a purchase and is the owner's call: raise it only on the owner's word (--floor).
